title: Marta profile
text: Es mi amiga. Se llama Marta. Es de Colombia. Vive en Lima. Habla español. Es simpática.
native_translation: She is my friend. Her name is Marta. She is from Colombia. She lives in Lima. She speaks Spanish. She is nice.

title: Two people
text: Carlos es profesor. Es de México. Vive en Madrid. Habla español. Elena es profesora. Es de España. Vive en Valencia. Es alta.
native_translation: Carlos is a teacher. He is from Mexico. He lives in Madrid. He speaks Spanish. Elena is a teacher. She is from Spain. She lives in Valencia. She is tall.

title: Class introduction
text: Hola. Ella es mi compañera. Se llama Ana. Es estudiante. Es joven. Habla español y un poco de inglés.
native_translation: Hello. She is my classmate. Her name is Ana. She is a student. She is young. She speaks Spanish and a little English.

title: Short message about a friend
text: Luis es mi amigo. Vive en Bogotá. Habla español. Es serio, pero simpático.
native_translation: Luis is my friend. He lives in Bogotá. He speaks Spanish. He is serious but nice.
